title: Single-level tower realization and reflection of the finite triangle identities
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $S$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Put $B_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ and $A_T=((B_n)_T)_n$, with quotient transitions, for schemes $T$ over $S$. Use the coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers] and their ordinary derived categories [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be comparison, and let $\mathscr C^+(T)$ be the full subcategory of $D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ whose every level has an etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], meaning it is isomorphic to $\nu_T^*L_n$ for some $L_n\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)$. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, $W=P\times_SP$, $q:P\to S$, $p_1,p_2:W\to P$, and let $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ be the diagonal [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Use the Tate twist, supported diagonal map $\delta_\bullet:\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$, and splitting traces $t_q,t_1,t_2$ of [det-sp-tower-classes]; here $t_i$ is the trace for $p_i$. Write $F=Rq_{*,\bullet}$ and $G=q_\bullet^*(-)(1)[2]$.
Fix $n\geq1$. For $T=S,P$ and $L\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)$, let $J_{n,T}L$ be the derived object of a bounded-below representative having $\nu_T^*L$ at level $n$ and zero at every other level, with zero transitions. This defines an exact functor $J_{n,T}:D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)\to\mathscr C^+(T)$ independent of the representative. Put $F_n=Rq_{*,B_n}$ and $G_n=q^{-1}(-)(1)[2]$ on the ordinary etale categories. There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$e_nFJ_{n,P}\simeq\nu_S^*F_n,\qquad e_nGJ_{n,S}\simeq\nu_P^*G_n,$$
compatible with the iterated operations $FG,G F$ and their specified tensor, projection, exchange and composition maps, where $e_n$ is exact level evaluation.
Let $\eta,\varepsilon$ be the natural maps defined by the diagonal and trace formulas in [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons], and let $\eta_n,\varepsilon_n$ denote the identical formulas on the ordinary etale sites with coefficients $B_n$. Their evaluations on $J_{n,T}$, under the preceding identifications, are $\nu^*\eta_n,\nu^*\varepsilon_n$. If $\varepsilon_{FM}\circ F\eta_M=1_{FM}$ for all $M\in\mathscr C^+(P)$ and $G\varepsilon_K\circ\eta_{GK}=1_{GK}$ for all $K\in\mathscr C^+(S)$, then
$$\varepsilon_{n,F_nL}\circ F_n\eta_{n,L}=1_{F_nL}\quad(L\in D^+(P_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)),$$
$$G_n\varepsilon_{n,H}\circ\eta_{n,G_nH}=1_{G_nH}\quad(H\in D^+(S_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)).$$
The reflected equalities are on the ordinary etale categories, via their fully faithful comparison [sk-prop-sf-comparison]; no compatible choice of etale representatives for an arbitrary tower and no normalized-tower hypothesis is imposed. The conclusion is conditional on the two tower identities, not a new assertion of the tower adjunction.

proof.text: Obtain the exact singleton comparisons c from [lem-sp-tower-p1-single-level-construction]. This constructs only the embeddings and normalized comparison isomorphisms.

Use [lem-sp-tower-p1-single-level-transport] to identify nu of each finite triangle composite, followed by its push or pull comparison, with that comparison followed by evaluation of the corresponding tower triangle composite. Substitute the assumed tower identities at c.projective.J L and c.base.J H. Functors preserve identities; cancel the invertible push or pull component.

The images of F_n L and G_n H under nu are isomorphic by push and pull to evaluated tower objects with retained bounded-below origins. Exact faithful realization and comparison reflect vanishing of cohomology, so those finite objects are bounded below. Use [sk-prop-sf-comparison] for faithfulness of comparison on D+, and derived realization equivalence for faithfulness after realization. Reflect each evaluated equality.

tool_uses.why: Generic inverse-image exactness for the comparison geometric morphism; the unit supplies no replacement for this site-theoretic fact.

There are no new nodes. The statement and stmt_deps are unchanged from the base. Live and side-live still show the item unsplit, there is no repair note (so this is not a re-split order), and no SGA source is cited. Source: the main-20261015 p1.proof.md 'Levels' paragraph, which is identical in latest. The item realises old parent steps 10-11, as the reviewed parent det-sp-tower-p1-adjunction (Q12 e152604f) assigns them, and the parent's step 5 cites it. Step 1: the zero-off-n functor s_{n,T} has zero transitions, which are trivially semilinear under sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers. It is exact because kernels and cokernels are levelwise (det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian (1)). nu^* is exact on B_n-modules via def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism and lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact. Step 2: the derived J comes from lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated (Stacks 015F, derived.tex l.5884, read). The witnesses (L,id) at level n and (0,id) elsewhere fit def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, and boundedness below is preserved. Step 3: e_n Rq_* = Rq_{*,n} e_n comes from lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections, whose hypotheses I checked. The comparisons node passes to the étale operations through the direct-image mate, and lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate makes that mate an isomorphism (q qcqs, D^+, finite B_n). The same node preserves C^+, which allows iterating, and it has no Tor hypothesis. Step 4: the comparisons node's last paragraph identifies e_n eta and e_n eps with nu^* of the finite formulas, including the p_i Delta = 1 identification, twists and shifts. Steps 5-6: apply the assumed tower identities at J-inputs, conjugate by a_L and b_H, and reflect by the full faithfulness of nu^* on D^+(X_et, Lambda) for any scheme and any ring Lambda (sk-prop-sf-comparison, current and blueprint_update). No claim that evaluation detects equality of tower morphisms is used. Edge cases checked: n=1, S empty, the zero complex, shifts, non-flat modules. Duplicates: the singleton left extensions lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension and lem-pur-system-singleton-scalar-extension / -geometric-pullback use scalar extension at lower levels, so they are a different functor. The P1 siblings have different content, and there is no blueprint same_as. Tool uses accepted: lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections and sk-prop-sf-comparison are already in the parent's merged tool_uses, and lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact is generic site exactness. sk-lem-sp-tower-levels gives only the objectwise isomorphism, so the semilinear-sections tool is needed. Advisory: the étale Tate twist is used without an étale twist def node; the comparisons node covers it.
